name: interpro-mcp-server
description: Search InterPro entries, map domains and functional sites onto UniProt proteins and PDB structures, find proteins by domain, and scan raw protein sequences via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search InterPro entries, map domains and functional sites onto UniProt proteins and PDB structures, find proteins by domain, and scan raw protein sequences via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Reads InterPro and the member databases it integrates (Pfam, PROSITE, SMART, CDD, PANTHER, and others) through the keyless EMBL-EBI API. Search InterPro entries by GO annotation or entries and member signatures by text or type, read their full metadata, map a UniProt protein's or a PDB entry's chains to domains, repeats, and functional sites with residue coordinates, walk Pfam, CDD, and PIRSF clans, find the proteins that carry a signature (by default reviewed human proteins, optionally within one proteome), and scan a raw protein sequence, from precalculated matches or an InterProScan job. Results are paged with cursors and no credentials are needed; submitting InterProScan jobs for sequences with no precalculated matches needs an operator-set contact email.
